snippet.title: Last Known Vector - Official Trailer
snippet.description:

https://www.tiktok.com/@burrow_studio

Last Known Vector is a sci-fi horror game where you travel between a space station and SOS signals. Your aging ship often breaks down, so keep it in good condition. But failures aren’t your only threat. In space, anomalies appear, and when they do, avoid the darkness at all costs.
